style: A single game-ready miniature wooden contraption part. Whimsical handcrafted toy, warm honey oak wood grain, rounded chunky edges, small dark iron fittings, brass bolts and restrained coral-red painted accents. Clean readable silhouette. Isolated object only, no ground, no scene, no text, no lettering, no extra objects. Y is up.

models.title: Marble
models.prompt: A perfectly round glossy coral-red wooden marble with a thin curved cream stripe. Smooth sphere, no face, no protrusions, no stand.

models.title: Ramp
models.prompt: A solid right triangular wooden wedge ramp, twice as long as wide. High vertical end on the LEFT, slopes smoothly down toward the RIGHT. Flat unobstructed inclined plank surface, no rails, no steps, no gaps. Solid triangular side panels, a few brass fasteners on the sides. Long direction is X, width is Z.

models.title: Shelf
models.prompt: One long flat horizontal rectangular oak shelf plank, length three times its width, thickness one fifth its width. Entire upper surface flat and clear. Dark iron corner brackets on the thin side edges. No legs, posts or rails. Long direction is X, width is Z.

models.title: Wall
models.prompt: A single upright rectangular toy wall panel, height twice its width, very thin depth. Honey oak boards framed by dark iron, brass corner bolts, a short coral-red painted band. Flat rectangular silhouette, flat top, no base or feet. Panel lies in the YZ plane, thickness is X.

models.title: Domino
models.prompt: One single upright rectangular wooden domino tile. Height twice its width, thickness one quarter of width. Pale butter-yellow enamel face with small dark round pips, natural oak rounded sides, coral-red edge accent. Exactly one tile, no base. Face lies in the YZ plane, thin direction is X.

models.title: Seesaw plank
models.prompt: ONLY the long thin straight horizontal wooden rocking plank of a toy seesaw, no pivot or stand. Four times longer than wide, very thin. Flat clear top for a rolling marble, coral-red paint at both ends, brass rivets in side edges. No handles, no seats, no legs. Long direction is X, width is Z.

models.title: Seesaw pivot
models.prompt: ONLY the small stationary fulcrum block of a toy seesaw, no plank. A short upright narrow oak block with a brass axle through its top from front to back. Flat stable bottom. Wider along Z than X, brass axle along Z. No ground or decoration.

models.title: Fan housing
models.prompt: ONLY a compact square vintage toy fan housing, without any blades or rotor. Square warm oak frame around a large round EMPTY OPEN circular aperture, open through the center. Brass corner rivets, coral-red corners, dark iron inner rim. No feet or stand, no grille, no central hub, no blades. Upright square face lies in YZ, opening points along X, depth half of height.

models.title: Fan rotor
models.prompt: ONLY one detached three-bladed propeller rotor for a small toy fan. Three rounded coral-red blades around a little round brass central hub. Symmetric balanced shape, no frame, no stand, no axle extension. Flat rotor lies in YZ plane, spin axis X.

models.title: Trampoline
models.prompt: A very low square toy trampoline, square flat coral-red fabric jumping pad stretched inside a honey oak square frame with tiny brass springs along its edges. Short dark iron feet. Width equals depth, height only one quarter of width. Top pad perfectly flat, horizontal and unobstructed. No railings or enclosure.

models.title: Cannon
models.prompt: A small playful toy cannon, chunky dark iron hollow barrel with brass rim pointing to the RIGHT, tilted upward by 25 degrees. Compact honey oak carriage with two small red wooden wheels and brass axle. Open muzzle clearly visible. No ammunition, no smoke, no ground. Barrel direction positive X, wheels axis Z. Squat compact proportions.

models.title: Catching bucket
models.prompt: An OPEN TOP square wooden catching bucket, a tall narrow square box made of thin oak planks with brass corner bands and coral-red outer trim. Empty hollow interior clearly visible all the way to flat bottom. Height one and one third its width, square footprint. Thin walls, square rim, no handle, no lid, no objects inside, no protrusions over opening.
